name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 28 times in 8 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 53 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.19 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
